subject: Request: Senior approval for 28% Hosted API commitment incentive for HelioSphere migration
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: HelioSphere migration — request for senior price concession (initial)

Kimberly,

Quick note on HelioSphere (HS) — they've committed to a two-year migration from their on-prem NLU stack to Redwood Hosted API. They want a price that reflects a multi-region launch (EU first, then NA) + a 1.5x token ramp in year one. Procurement is pushing hard for a blended unit price that is ~28% below our standard hosted tier.

Why this matters:
- Strategic logo (healthcare AI); public case study potential in EU.
- Expected committed spend: ~$1.2M ARR year1 (hosted tokens + support).
- Multi-region and data residency work will create one-off engineering lift we should account for.

Ask: Can we get senior authorization for a 28% commitment incentive (applies to committed-hosted token pricing for 24 months), subject to a signed SOW and standard legal safe-guards? I attached the current pricing worksheet and SOW draft.

Key constraints from HS: signed contract before end of Q4EU (they have an internal board on Dec 10).

I'll include a short ROI calc and recommended guardrails in my next message.

— Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_hosted_pricing_proposal_v3.xlsx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: HelioSphere migration — request for senior price concession (initial)

Thanks Ben — got it. I'm looped in because this is above the 20% approval threshold and touches multi-region compliance items. Marcus / Revenue Ops, please run the expected unit economics and dilution impact on committed ARR if we approve 28% for two years.

From a legal/compliance POV, Laura: we will need a clear data residency appendix + warranty limits for the migration period. Please flag any material risks.

Also: can we structure the concession as a time-bound committed discount (i.e., applies only to committed tokens up to the committed volume) with a step-down if consumption undershoots? That will protect unit economics.

Kimberly
Head of Sales EMEA
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: HelioSphere migration — request for senior price concession (initial)

Kimberly — ran the numbers against the proposed commitment. Highlights:
- Projected committed ARR (year1): $1,200,000; expected net new hosted revenue over 24 months: $2.3M.
- Baseline unit cost (our hosted blended cost after infra & support): $0.00028/token.
- Proposed 28% discount reduces unit price to ~$0.000202/token.
- With the engineering migration work (estimated one-time cost $120k) and expected caching/batching gains over time, the gross margin impact in year1 is ~12 ppts.

Safeguards I propose so this doesn't set a precedent:
1) Discount scoped to a named contract (HS-2026-1129) and applies only to committed tokens up to the commitment amount; overages bill at standard rate.
2) Minimum payment schedule: 50% of year1 commitment upfront or via irrevocable bank guarantee.
3) Performance milestones tied to roll-out: EU launch (M1), NA pilot (M8); failure to hit M1 allows unilateral reprice.
4) Sunset clause after 24 months; no auto-renew at the discounted level.

If those guardrails are acceptable, this looks financially tolerable given strategic upside. I can provide a short P&L for the quarter.

— Marcus
Director, Revenue Operations
(attachment: HelioSphere_Migration_SOW_v2.pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:16:00-08:00
Subject: Re: HelioSphere migration — request for senior price concession (initial)

Team — I reviewed strategic fit with GTM leadership. Recommendation: approve a maximum of 28% on the committed-hosted tokens only, contingent on the revenue ops guardrails Marcus proposed and legal sign-off. Rationale:
- Strong channel signal for EMEA + potential reference/case study in Q2.
- Customer is willing to co-fund some engineering work (mentioned in SOW) which reduces our one-time cost.
- Competitive risk: competitor X is pitching a shallow discount but no compliance guarantees — HS values our residency and traceability.

Requesting Kimberly to escalate to Rishi for final exec sign-off (exception over 20%). If we can get a yes by COB 2026-11-30 EU hours, we can meet HS timeline.

— Mina
VP Sales, Strategic Accounts

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T07:41:00-08:00
Subject: Re: HelioSphere migration — request for senior price concession (legal notes)

Team — quick legal read:
- Data residency appendix: will require EU processing and control language + audited subprocessor list. We can accommodate but need 30 days for review and a SOC2 addendum.
- Liability cap: do not accept >2x fees cap for production downtime caused by migration activities. Recommend 1x fees cap.
- Payment guarantees: ask for an advance payment or letter of credit; don't accept unsecured deferred schedules for >50% committed value.
- Termination for convenience: we should add a 60-day cure period and pro-rated true-up for consumed tokens.

If Marcus and Ben confirm payment schedule language, legal can fast-track the SOW redlines.

— Laura
Senior Counsel, Contracts

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Approval request: 28% commitment incentive for HelioSphere (HS-2026-1129) — need exec sign-off

Rishi — brief ask: HelioSphere is requesting a 28% discount on committed hosted token pricing for a 24-month committed agreement tied to a $1.2M ARR first-year commitment. GTM and RevOps endorse but this exceeds the standard 20% floor and requires exec sign-off.

Proposed guardrails (summary):
- Discount applies only to committed tokens up to the agreed volume; overages billed at list.
- 50% of year1 committed value due at signature (or bank guarantee).
- Migration milestones and EU data residency appendix in SOW; failure to hit EU launch allows reprice.
- 24-month sunset; no auto-extend at discount.
- Liability cap at 1x fees and standard SOC2 addendum.

Attachments: pricing worksheet + SOW draft.

Can you confirm approval (or provide alternative direction) by EOD 2026-11-30 EU time? HS needs final contract for their Dec 10 board.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales EMEA
Redwood Inference
(attachments: redwood_hosted_pricing_proposal_v3.xlsx, HelioSphere_Migration_SOW_v2.pdf)
